project_type: MERN stack: Express.js backend + React admin panel frontend for bottle production management
build_system: npm workspaces with separate Backend and 'admin panel' directories; build via npm scripts
test_framework: Not explicitly configured (testing via manual API calls and browser testing)
build_command: npm run build (if available) or individual workspace builds
test_command: Manual testing via curl/browser; no automated test suite visible
verification_instructions: 1. Backend: Start server (npm start in Backend), test endpoints via curl. 2. Frontend: Start dev server (npm start in admin panel), test in browser. 3. Database: Use real test data from MongoDB.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None identified (all data is dynamic from database)
environment_constraints: Never restart the dev server on :9001 (if in use); database connection required; no git commands allowed for this task
contribution_requirements: Read reference document ORDER-QTY-VS-STOCK-WARNING-PROMPT.md; follow existing code patterns (helper functions for complex logic, API endpoint naming conventions); test scenarios must all pass before marking complete
key_patterns: 1. Stock calculation uses recomputePlainStock() utility. 2. Completed row detection via isPlanRowCompleted() helper. 3. Alert/warnings via Swal.fire() and React state. 4. Form validation before API calls. 5. Error codes returned in response body (e.g., 'STOCK_WARNING_REQUIRED'). 6. Metadata fields stored with underscore prefix (e.g., stockWarningAcknowledged, acknowledgedAt).
directory_structure: Backend/src/models/* (database schemas), Backend/src/controllers/* (business logic), Backend/src/routes/* (API routes), admin panel/src/pages/LacquerPlan/* (UI components), admin panel/src/redux/slices/* (state management), admin panel/src/services/api.js (API client)
